courses.title: 25 Hour Yoga Nidra Teacher Training
courses.description: A self-paced online training in leading yoga nidra, in eight modules: foundations and history, sleep and the brain, the koshas and sankalpa, Kelly's 'blueprint' for building a class, sample classes and scripts, and teaching groups and individuals. Monthly live office hours with Kelly, a reviewed final project and a certificate worth 25 Yoga Alliance continuing-education hours; open to non-teachers too.

courses.title: Nervous System Regulation Meditation Script Bundle
courses.description: A PDF of seven meditation scripts written by Kelly for teachers and coaches to read aloud, including a nervous system reset, a body scan, an overwhelm reset and short breath-based practices for settling. Commercial use in classes, sessions and recordings is included.

courses.title: Prenatal Meditation Script Bundle
courses.description: A PDF of nine guided meditation scripts for pregnancy, 5 to 20 minutes long, written by Kelly for teachers and wellness professionals to lead: connecting and breathing with the baby, body love, self-care, and practices for stress, worry, fatigue and restless nights.
